call_book.mapping: a USD-bullish call is a short on each of the four dollar-quoted markets, a USD-bearish call a long; a session with no call is not traded, and a session with no call for a model is named in the ledger

inputs.sizing: one percent of the running balance per filled trade, lots rounded to the instrument's own step, on each £100,000 model and geometry account

eligibility.rule: a session may be priced by the ladder only when its 05:00 London start is later than the ladder's own stamp, so the lines were already in the file when the session was traded

bars_check.verdict: every rebuilt bar that overlaps the broker's own M5 history agrees to within one instrument point
rebuilt bars are the broker's own bars to within a point

limits: the direction is the published model's own call per session; the sweep never invents a side for a session nobody called
commission, swap and stop slippage are not carried, so every figure is gross
a session with no streamed tape is a retrieval failure and is counted apart from a session that streamed and carried nothing
the ladder is one hand-marked grid per asset, so it is the same lines for every eligible session rather than a fresh mark each day
challenger_v1's calls are carried in factors_read_by_date for provenance but are not sized: the four accounts are the brief's four slots
